agencies_lifecycle_consistent.name: agencies_lifecycle_consistent
agencies_lifecycle_consistent.value:
("agencies"."status" = 'PROVISIONING' AND "agencies"."bootstrap_completed_at" IS NULL AND "agencies"."activated_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("agencies"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "agencies"."bootstrap_completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agencies"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL)

agency_memberships_lifecycle_consistent.name: agency_memberships_lifecycle_consistent
agency_memberships_lifecycle_consistent.value:
("agency_memberships"."status" = 'INVITED')
          OR ("agency_memberships"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "agency_memberships"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("agency_memberships"."status" = 'SUSPENDED' AND "agency_memberships"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agency_memberships"."suspended_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("agency_memberships"."status" = 'INACTIVE' AND "agency_memberships"."inactivated_at" IS NOT NULL)

auth_identities_lifecycle_consistent.name: auth_identities_lifecycle_consistent
auth_identities_lifecycle_consistent.value:
("auth_identities"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "auth_identities"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("auth_identities"."status" = 'REVOKED' AND "auth_identities"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

customers_type_fields_valid.name: customers_type_fields_valid
customers_type_fields_valid.value:
("customers"."type" = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND "customers"."company_title" IS NULL)
          OR ("customers"."type" = 'COMPANY' AND "customers"."first_name" IS NULL AND "customers"."last_name" IS NULL)

policies_archive_consistent.name: policies_archive_consistent
policies_archive_consistent.value: ("policies"."archived_at" IS NULL AND "policies"."archived_by_membership_id" IS NULL AND "policies"."archive_reason" IS NULL) OR ("policies"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL AND "policies"."archived_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("policies"."archive_reason")) > 0)

policy_amendments_money_consistent.name: policy_amendments_money_consistent
policy_amendments_money_consistent.value: ("policy_amendments"."premium_difference_minor" IS NULL AND "policy_amendments"."currency" IS NULL) OR ("policy_amendments"."premium_difference_minor" IS NOT NULL AND length("policy_amendments"."currency")=3 AND "policy_amendments"."currency"=upper("policy_amendments"."currency"))

policy_parties_lifecycle_consistent.name: policy_parties_lifecycle_consistent
policy_parties_lifecycle_consistent.value: ("policy_parties"."status"='ACTIVE' AND "policy_parties"."deactivated_at" IS NULL AND "policy_parties"."deactivated_by_membership_id" IS NULL) OR ("policy_parties"."status"='INACTIVE' AND "policy_parties"."deactivated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "policy_parties"."deactivated_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL)

renewal_opportunities_terminal_fields_co.name: renewal_opportunities_terminal_fields_consistent
renewal_opportunities_terminal_fields_co.value: ("renewal_opportunities"."state" IN ('WON','LOST','VOIDED') AND "renewal_opportunities"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "renewal_opportunities"."closed_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("renewal_opportunities"."state" NOT IN ('WON','LOST','VOIDED') AND "renewal_opportunities"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "renewal_opportunities"."closed_by_membership_id" IS NULL)

renewal_opportunities_loss_reason_consis.name: renewal_opportunities_loss_reason_consistent
renewal_opportunities_loss_reason_consis.value: ("renewal_opportunities"."state"='LOST' AND "renewal_opportunities"."loss_reason_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("renewal_opportunities"."state"<>'LOST' AND "renewal_opportunities"."loss_reason_id" IS NULL AND "renewal_opportunities"."loss_reason_notes" IS NULL)

renewal_opportunities_void_reason_consis.name: renewal_opportunities_void_reason_consistent
renewal_opportunities_void_reason_consis.value: ("renewal_opportunities"."state"='VOIDED' AND "renewal_opportunities"."void_reason_code" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("renewal_opportunities"."void_reason_code"))>0) OR ("renewal_opportunities"."state"<>'VOIDED' AND "renewal_opportunities"."void_reason_code" IS NULL)

renewal_state_history_actor_consistent.name: renewal_state_history_actor_consistent
renewal_state_history_actor_consistent.value: ("renewal_state_history"."actor_kind"='USER' AND "renewal_state_history"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "renewal_state_history"."actor_membership_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("renewal_state_history"."actor_kind"='SYSTEM' AND "renewal_state_history"."actor_user_id" IS NULL AND "renewal_state_history"."actor_membership_id" IS NULL)

sensitive_action_grants_lifecycle_consis.name: sensitive_action_grants_lifecycle_consistent
sensitive_action_grants_lifecycle_consis.value:
("sensitive_action_grants"."status" = 'ISSUED' AND "sensitive_action_grants"."consumed_at" IS NULL AND "sensitive_action_grants"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "sensitive_action_grants"."consumed_operation_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("sensitive_action_grants"."status" = 'CONSUMED' AND "sensitive_action_grants"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sensitive_action_grants"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("sensitive_action_grants"."status" = 'REVOKED' AND "sensitive_action_grants"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

tasks_kind_parent_consistent.name: tasks_kind_parent_consistent
tasks_kind_parent_consistent.value: ("tasks"."kind"='RENEWAL_FOLLOWUP' AND "tasks"."renewal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."policy_id" IS NULL) OR ("tasks"."kind"='GENERAL' AND "tasks"."renewal_id" IS NULL)

tasks_completion_consistent.name: tasks_completion_consistent
tasks_completion_consistent.value: ("tasks"."status"='OPEN' AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "tasks"."completed_by_membership_id" IS NULL) OR ("tasks"."status"='COMPLETED' AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."completed_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL)

tasks_creator_consistent.name: tasks_creator_consistent
tasks_creator_consistent.value: ("tasks"."actor_kind"='USER' AND "tasks"."created_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."created_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("tasks"."actor_kind"='SYSTEM' AND "tasks"."created_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."created_by_membership_id" IS NULL)
